2Make her crack

  • ✋Grab and stretch her face. Pull her cheeks, chin, forehead.
  • 😂Wiggle fast back and forth to crack her up. 😂 Cracked her 0x
  • 👆Tap her for a reaction. Touch her nose and watch her eyes.
  • 😤Keep poking and she gets annoyed. Ignore her and she gets bored.

3Snap it

Hit Snap, then stretch her face before the timer runs out.

Use a nickname, not a full name. Nothing you type or snap leaves your device unless you share it.

On a phone, Share opens Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok and Messages. You can also press and hold the picture to save it.
